title: Yummy Venezuelan Beans Stew
description: A funky, tender stew that soothes hangovers with a smoky clay pot finish, using vegetable shortening for authentic texture.
instructions: Heat the clay pot over medium heat and melt the vegetable shortening with the olive oil.
Add the chopped onion, garlic, carrot, and celery, sautéing until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the drained beans and pour in the chicken broth, adding the bay leaf.
Season with salt and pepper, bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Cover the pot and let it cook for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the bay leaf, garnish with fresh cilantro, and check seasoning.
Serve the stew hot, optionally with a side of brown rice or whole grain bread.
Enjoy the comforting, hangover‑cure flavor of this Venezuelan staple.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
